title: Prototype Pollution in parse-git-config via expandKeys
longFix: expandKeys built nested objects from git config section names without guarding reserved property names; a section such as [__proto__ "x"] polluted Object.prototype. Section/subsection names resolving to __proto__/constructor/prototype are now rejected.
summary: parse-git-config's expandKeys() turns git-config section names into nested objects. With no guard on reserved keys, a crafted .git/config (e.g. from an untrusted repository) parsed with expandKeys:true could mutate Object.prototype for the whole process.
fixExplanation: Section and subsection names that resolve to __proto__, constructor, or prototype are dropped. Legitimate git configuration is unaffected (no real .gitconfig has a section literally named __proto__).
